name: Five Days Christian Tour Of Egypt Cairo and Saint Catherine
description: Get rest from your busy days and make unforgettable Holy Tours in Egypt to Cairo and Saint Catherine, drive from Cairo to Saint Catherine via Sharm El Sheikh and amuse yourself in Saint Catherine Monastery, Burning Bush and Room of the skulls. Also you have the chance to visit the amazing Giza Pyramids, Sphinx and Egyptian Museum in Cairo, moreover special visit to Cairo Coptic area and know the Christian history in Egypt during your Holy Tours to Cairo and Saint Catherine.
overview: Get rest from your busy days and make unforgettable Holy Tours in Egypt to Cairo and Saint Catherine, drive from Cairo to Saint Catherine via Sharm El Sheikh and amuse yourself in Saint Catherine Monastery, Burning Bush and Room of the skulls. Also you have the chance to visit the amazing Giza Pyramids, Sphinx and Egyptian Museum in Cairo, moreover special visit to Cairo Coptic area and know the Christian history in Egypt during your Holy Tours to Cairo and Saint Catherine.

itinerary.title: Arrive Cairo
itinerary.description: Once your flight landing at Cairo airport, Ibis Egypt Tours representative will be waiting for you, holding a sign with your name, then he will transfer you to your hotel in Cairo. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Pyramids – Museum – Coptic Cairo Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy tasty breakfast at your hotel, then Ibis Egypt tours tour guide will escort you to Pyramids of Giza and The Egyptian Museum, start your tour by visiting the three Pyramids of Cheops, Chephren and Mykerinus, then move to Panorama area, enjoy fabulous photos for the three Pyramids, next move to the Sphinx, visit the Valley Temple, Enjoy Lunch at an oriental restaurant in Cairo , continue visiting the Egyptian Museum, it is one of the most famous museums in the world, next round will be to Old Cairo including visits to the various Churches there ( Visit maximum 02 churches ), visit Ben Ezra Synagogue, at the end of your day tours back to your hotel. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Cairo Saint Catherine Tour
itinerary.description: Ibis Egypt tours tour guide will pick you up from your hotel in Cairo, he will escort you by air-conditioned vehicle to unforgettable trip to Saint Catherine, passing by Moses Eyes, continue driving till arrive to the seven daughters Monastery, have a short visit to the seven Daughters Monastery, continue driving till arrive to Saint Catherine, check in, manage to relax at hotel, enjoy the relish of your dinner at hotel. Overnight in Saint Catherine

itinerary.title: Moses Mountains, Saint Catherine Monastery
itinerary.description: Wake up call at 01:30 am., A cup of tea will be offered to each person for free, around 02:00 am, it is your chance to escape the crowds, try different adventure while climbing Moses mountain, enjoy the sun rising over Sinai Mountains, then come down for a magical visit to Saint Catherine Monastery, passing by Room of the Skulls, the last point will be to the famous burning bush, at the end of your tour drive back to Cairo Note: You can travel to Israel or Jordan from Taba border via extra transfer against Cairo Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Day 5: Final Departure
itinerary.description: Today we will say good bye to Egypt, once you enjoy your tasty breakfast, Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to Cairo International airport for final departure

inclusions: Meet & assist at Cairo International Airport plus transfer to hotel by air-conditioned modern Van.
Accommodation for 3 Nights in Cairo on Bed & Breakfast
Accommodation for 1 Night in Saint Catherine including breakfast and dinner
01 Day Excursion in Cairo as mentioned at the above itinerary
01 Lunch at good quality restaurant in Cairo
A Bottle of Mineral Water to each person
English speaking guide in Cairo during your tours
All Entrance fees to the above mentioned Excursions as mentioned at the itinerary
Transfer to Cairo International airport for your final departure.
Long Transfers from Cairo/ Saint Catherine/ Cairo
